body:
🟡🏛️ **Consider · adr: Switching to Opus 5.5 contradicts ADR 0028's decision 1 with no amendment**

ADR 0028 is accepted, and its decision 1 says "**Claude Sonnet 5.5 reviews a pull request**" (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:31`). Its frontmatter description says the same (line 3). This line moves the review to `claude-opus-5-5`, but the PR does not touch the ADR. The ADR already records later engine changes as dated amendments (lines 83–101).

Suggested fix: add an amendment, e.g. "Amendment: reviews run on Opus 5.5" dated 2026-10-29. Put the model change and the cost reasoning from this PR's body in it, and update the Status row. The ADR stays append-only, so leave decision 1 as written and let the amendment record the change.
